+from langdetect.utils.ngram import NGram
+
+# Create a modified version of NGram with potentially better initialization
+class FixedNGram(NGram):
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.grams = ''  # Start with empty string instead of space
+        self.capitalword = False
+    
+    def add_char(self, ch):
+        '''Append a character into ngram buffer.'''
+        ch = self.normalize(ch)
+        
+        # Handle empty grams case
+        if not self.grams:
+            if ch == ' ':
+                return  # Ignore leading spaces
+            self.grams = ' ' + ch  # Start with space + char for proper n-gram formation
+            self.capitalword = False
+            return
+            
+        last_char = self.grams[-1]
+        if last_char == ' ':
+            self.grams = ' '
+            self.capitalword = False
+            if ch == ' ':
+                return
+        elif len(self.grams) >= self.N_GRAM:
+            self.grams = self.grams[1:]
+        self.grams += ch
+
+        if ch.isupper():
+            if last_char.isupper():
+                self.capitalword = True
+        else:
